reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to The Synopsis, a Speedwell Research podcast. My name is Drew Cohen, and today we are going to be reading one of our memos, which is an excerpt from our Axon Research Report. Remember, guys, you could get the full research report at speedwellresearch.com.

key_points.text: This is a 77-page report that goes into all sorts of details on Axon, the very early history.
key_points.evidence_quote: This is a 77-page report that goes into all sorts of details on Axon, the very early history, which we're going to be reading about today, as well as competitive dynamics, the moat, the business, and also a lot on entrepreneur, Rick Smith, who is really an understudied entrepreneur.

key_points.text: He pivoted this business multiple times.
key_points.evidence_quote: He pivoted this business multiple times, and the product he starts this business with Tazers was itself a failed product that could not get traction for the better part of two to three decades.

key_points.text: And so it is a really interesting story from an entrepreneurial perspective, but also quite an interesting business to learn about.
